title: Model Availability Cohort Tester and Signal Tiling Playbook
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Objective: Build a reproducible, automated capability that detects model availability and behavioral drift across major public and partner model sources, organizes observations into ‘cohorts’ (by provider, region, quantization/variant, and latency tier), and surfaces tiled competitive signals for product and sales use.

Scope: 1) signal ingestion connectors (provider status pages, provider APIs, public issue trackers, telemetry sampling of model outputs via synthetic workloads); 2) cohort definition and enrichment (region, model flavor, quant profile, documented latency buckets); 3) daily signal tiling engine that produces ranked alerts and a time-series feed; 4) UX + API: small console view for PMs and GTM, and webhook/Slack alerting for ops.

Hypotheses: a) A small set (top 10) of cohort-level signals explain ~70% of customer fallback events; b) Tiled signals with trend annotations reduce time-to-detect by at least 2x versus manual checks.

Measurement & Success Criteria: 1) daily coverage: >90% of targeted provider/model combinations report at least one pulse per day; 2) detection lead time: average detection-to-alert <= 45 minutes for outages and >= 48h trajectory flags for degradation; 3) usefulness: at least two active product or sales playbooks use the feed in the first 6 weeks.

Deliverables: - Signals ingestion pipeline (connectors + standardized schema CSV/JSON output) - Cohort classifier and enrichment table - Signal tiler service producing ranked, time-bucketed tiles (CSV & JSON) - Console prototype: cohort map and top-5 active signals - Alerting rules and webhook integration - Runbook/operations doc for interpretation and triage

Data sources: Provider status pages (OpenAI/Azure/GCP partner pages), model catalog APIs (public and partner-specific), public incident trackers, GitHub issue scrapes, internal sampling of model responses (synthetic workloads), customer telemetry for fallback events (privacy-safe signals only).

Risks & Mitigations: - Provider API rate limits: batch polling windows and exponential backoff; cache canonical model metadata. - False positives from noisy public feeds: require multi-source confirmation for P1 alerts. - Customer telemetry delays: use synthetic probes as proxy to catch latency/regression early.

Stakeholders: PM (Asha Patel), Signals Eng (ENG-6210 owner), Observability (SRE), Sales Ops, Solutions Eng, Data Privacy & Legal.

Acceptance Criteria: - End-to-end daily feed in staging for a minimum of 30 model/provider cohorts; - Console page with cohort tiles and ability to filter by region and latency tier; - Alerting to Slack webhook with sample alerts; - Runbook and README published in Confluence and linked in ticket.
